chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Suleyman, from Al-Husayn ibn Umar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'A man bequeathed to me something in the Way (of God/Jihad).' He said to me, 'Spend it on Hajj.' I said to him, 'He bequeathed to me in the Way.' He said, 'Spend it on Hajj, for I do not know anything from His Way that is superior to Hajj.'

key_terms.السَّبِيلِ: The Way (of God), often referring to Jihad or general charitable causes

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on spending money bequeathed for 'Sabil Allah' if the specific purpose is not defined?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the interpretation of 'Sabil Allah' in bequests by prioritizing Hajj as the preeminent act of worship within that category. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that when a specific beneficiary of 'the Way' is not explicitly defined, the Imam has the discretion to allocate funds to the most virtuous obligation, thereby ensuring the bequest fulfills its highest spiritual potential.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammmad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Al Husayn Bin Umar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man (in Wilayah) bequeathed something in the Way (Jihad)’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Spend it regarding the Hajj’. I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘He bequeathed to me (to be in) the Way (Jihad)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Spend it regarding the Hajj, for I<sup>asws</sup> do not know of anything from His<sup>azwj</sup> Way being superior than the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from al- Husayn ibn ‘Umar who has narrated the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who has made a will to spend in the way of Allah. He (the Imam) said to me to spend it for al-Haj j . I said that he has said to spend it in the way of Allah. He (the Imam) said, ‘Spend for al-Hajj because I do not see anything in His way better than al-Hajj.”’
